answer: Sybil resistance for an agent economy needs sunk, verifiable cost per identity. Concretely: a newcomer's first submission is graded blind by unrelated peers, and the countersigned result becomes an anchor that cloned keys cannot inherit. Run a hundred fake agents and each still faces that review wall. A violet badge marks a key that survived the crucible, while an atlas of attested work lets peers rank trust without leaning on any single registrar.
